function: Transceiver design for over-the-air FL aggregation with differential privacy: device transmit scaling, artificial-noise power and BS receive beamforming by alternating optimization; learned part is the FL model (pp. 5-10).
system: N=20-antenna BS server, M=10 single-antenna devices, analog over-the-air uplink, perfect CSI, Rayleigh fading; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 10).
method: Not learned: alternating optimization with MMSE extractor, SDP and DC penalty, linear program. Learned element: ridge regression and CNNs (Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10) trained by federated learning (pp. 9-14).
data_channel: Synthetic ridge regression data (K=1000, d=20) over i.i.d. Rayleigh fading with CN(0, I_N) channels; Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 for CNN tasks; no standard channel model (pp. 10, 13).
test_conditions: Single configuration with 500 Monte Carlo trials, T=30 rounds (T=300 for image tasks); sweeps over privacy level, SNR, rounds, BS antennas, CSI error; 10,000 test images (pp. 10-13).
baselines: DP-free MIMO design (stated identical to [8], [9]); single-antenna DP design (stated to align with [19]); single-antenna without DP; conventional-combiner and random information extractors in Fig. 2 (pp. 11-12).
metrics: Normalized optimality gap of ridge regression versus privacy level, SNR, rounds, antennas, CSI error; achievable DP at the BS; training loss and test accuracy on image tasks (pp. 11-14).
q1_support: p. 10: "a Raleigh fading channel model". Custom Rayleigh fading with channel vectors drawn from CN(0, I_N) and synthetic data; no 3GPP, COST 2100 or DeepMIMO model and no measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "averaged over 500 Monte Carlo trials". Figs. 3-7 (pp. 11-12) sweep privacy level, SNR, rounds, antennas and CSI error, which are sweeps or fresh designs for each setting; no trained model is tested in an unseen scenario.
q3_support: p. 11: "this solution aligns with the state-of-the-art result in [19]" and "The solution is identical to that in the existing work on DP-unaware FL [8], [9]"; compared on the normalized optimality gap (Figs. 3-7, pp. 11-12).
q4_support: p. 10: "criterion is added to save computational time". Only a qualitative remark; no order of complexity, operations or runtime of Algorithm 1 is reported (the model sizes d on p. 13 are the FL model, not the design).
q5_support: p. 13: "trained on the Fashion-MNIST [39] and CIFAR-10". Learning-task datasets only; the channels are simulated (p. 10) and the paper gives no code or data link.
notes: Preprint (arXiv 2306.10982v3). Included as federated learning over the air (area 7): the aggregation transceiver (device scaling, artificial noise, BS combining) comes from alternating optimization and closed forms, not learning; the learned element is the FL model (pp. 4-10). Multi-antenna BS, so the system check passes. q3 is borderline: the baselines are the authors' own special cases (N=1 design and the design without the DP constraint) that the paper states coincide with [19] and [8], [9] (p. 11), not the original implementations; reviewer to confirm that this counts as earlier published aggregation designs.
